quiérovos: querer + vos — I want (to) you (quiero, present 1st sg., + enclitic vos; Quiérovos dezir 'I want to tell you'; = os quiero)
pueblo: pueblo — people, population, community (el pueblo de moros 'the Moorish population'; = pueblo)
yente: yente — people, folk (sg.; = gente; y- from Latin g-; la yente cristiana 'the Christian folk')
cristiana: cristiano — Christian (fem. sg.; la yente cristiana 'the Christian people'; = cristiana)
asil: así + le — thus ... it (así 'thus' + enclitic le 'it'; asil dirán por carta 'so they will call it in writing'; = así le)
dirán: dezir — they will say, they will call (future 3rd pl.; = dirán)
mucha: mucho — much, a great deal of (fem. sg.; mucha tierra 'much land'; = mucha)
preava: prear — he was plundering, raiding (imperfect 3rd sg.; mucha tierra preava 'he plundered much land'; = saqueaba, closest)
río: río — river (río Martín 'the Martín river'; = río)
saragoça: Saragoça — Zaragoza, city on the Ebro, seat of a Moorish kingdom (= Zaragoza)
nuevas: nueva — news, tidings (fem. pl.; sus nuevas legavan 'his news was arriving'; = noticias, nuevas)
legavan: llegar — they were arriving (imperfect 3rd pl.; spelling leg- for lleg-; = llegaban)
sovo: seer — he stayed, he was (strong preterite 3rd sg.; Allí sovo mio Çid 'there the Cid stayed'; = estuvo)
conplidas: conplido — complete, full (fem. pl.; conplidas quinze sedmanas 'a full fifteen weeks'; = cumplidas)
tardava: tardar — he was delaying, was late (imperfect 3rd sg., reflexive; que se tardava Minaya 'that Minaya was delaying'; = se tardaba)
trasnochada: trasnochada — night march, a ride through the night (noun from trasnochar; fizo una trasnochada 'he made a night march'; = trasnochada, closest marcha nocturna)
desenparava: desenparar — he was abandoning, leaving (imperfect 3rd sg.; todo lo desenparava 'he was abandoning it all'; = desamparaba)
allén: allén — beyond (preposition with de; allén de Teruel 'beyond Teruel'; = allende)
pinar: pinar — pine wood, pine forest (el pinar de Tévar 'the pine wood of Tévar'; = pinar)
tévar: Tévar — Tévar, place name of a pine wood where the Cid camped (el pinar de Tévar; = Tévar)
metuda: meter — put, placed (past part. fem. sg., old form in -udo, agreeing with the object; metuda lâ en paria 'he has put it under tribute'; = metida)
lâ: la + a — it + has (la, object pronoun for Saragoça, + a = ha, aver 3rd sg. as perfect auxiliary, run together by Pidal with a circumflex; metuda lâ en paria 'he has put it under tribute'; = la ha; reading uncertain)
çiñen: çeñir — they gird, wear (present 3rd pl.; que todos çiñen espadas 'all of whom wear swords'; = ciñen)
asomar: asomar — to appear, come into view (infinitive; vido asomar a Minaya 'saw Minaya appear'; = asomar)
corriendo: correr — running, at a gallop (gerund; el cavallo corriendo 'the horse galloping'; = corriendo)
valo: va + lo — he goes ... him (va, present 3rd sg. of ir, + enclitic lo; ir + infinitive; valo abraçar 'he goes to embrace him'; = lo va)
boca: boca — mouth (besóle la boca 'he kissed his mouth'; = boca)
encubre: encubrir — he conceals, hides (present 3rd sg.; nol encubre nada 'he hides nothing from him'; = encubre)
álvar: Álvar — Álvar (given name of Minaya, Álvar Fáñez; = Álvar)
assi: assí — thus, so (printed assi, unaccented; = así; Minaya Álvar Fáñez assi era llegado 'Minaya had thus arrived')
llegado: llegar — arrived (past part.; era llegado 'had arrived', ser as perfect auxiliary; = llegado)
diziéndoles: dezir + les — saying to them (gerund + enclitic les; diziéndoles saludes 'bringing them greetings'; = diciéndoles)
saludes: salud — greeting; news of an absent person (pl.; Pidal: saludes 'noticias de una persona ausente'; diziéndoles saludes de primos 'bringing them news of their cousins'; = saludos, noticias)
alegría: alegría — joy, gladness (fizo grant alegría 'he showed great joy'; = alegría)
bivades: bivir — may you live (present subjunctive 2nd pl., optative; bivades muchos días 'may you live many days'; = viváis)
valedes: valer — you are worth (present 2nd pl.; más valedes que nos 'you are worth more than we'; = valéis)
mandadería: mandadería — errand, message carried, mission (noun, from mandado/mandadero; tan buena mandadería 'such a good errand'; no modern form, closest mensaje, recado)
tardó: tardar — he delayed (preterite 3rd sg.; non lo tardó 'he did not delay it'; = tardó)
escollechos: escoger — chosen, picked (past part. masc. pl., old irregular form; escollechos a mano 'hand-picked'; = escogidos)
corrida: corrida — raid, foray (noun from correr; fizo una corrida 'he made a raid'; = corrida, closest correría)
trasnochando: trasnochar — riding through the night (gerund; la noch trasnochando 'riding through the night'; = trasnochando)
alcañiz: Alcañiz — town in Teruel province (= Alcañiz)
negras: negro — black (fem. pl.; negras las va parando 'he goes leaving them black', i.e. waste, barren: Pidal 'yermas, estériles', as opposed to tierra blanca, sown land; = yermas)
parando: parar — leaving, putting in a state (gerund; las va parando negras 'he goes leaving them black'; = parando, closest dejando)
preando: prear — plundering (gerund; todo lo va preando 'he goes plundering everything'; = saqueando)
terçer: terçero — third (apocopated before a noun; al terçer día 'on the third day'; = tercer)
ixo: exir — he went out, set out (preterite 3rd sg.; don ixo 'from where he set out'; = salió)
hya: ya — now, already (h- spelling variant of ya; Hya va el mandado 'now the news goes'; = ya)
monçon: Monçon — Monzón, town in Huesca province (= Monzón)
huosca: Huesca — city in Aragon (Pidal's Hu[o]sca; = Huesca)
temién: temer — they feared (imperfect 3rd pl.; non temién ninguna fonta 'they feared no harm'; = temían)
ninguna: ninguno — no, any (fem. sg., with a negative; non temién ninguna fonta 'they feared no harm at all'; = ninguna)
fonta: fonta — outrage, affront; harm (Pidal: 'ultraje, afrenta', and 'daño' in general; tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront'; non temién ninguna fonta 'they feared no harm'; = afrenta, ultraje)
alegres: alegre — glad, happy (pl.; todos son alegres 'all are glad'; = alegres)
verdad: verdad — truth (dezir vos he la verdad 'I shall tell you the truth'; = verdad)
mora: morar — he stays, dwells (present 3rd sg.; qui en un logar mora siempre 'he who stays always in one place'; = mora)
menguar: menguar — to diminish, grow less (infinitive; lo so puede menguar 'what is his may dwindle'; = menguar)
dexat: dexar — leave (imperative 2nd pl., dexad; dexat estas posadas 'leave these quarters'; = dejad)
iremos: ir — we shall go (future 1st pl.; iremos adelant 'we shall go onward'; = iremos)
estonçes: estonçes — then, at that time (= entonces)
mudó: mudar — he moved, changed (preterite 3rd sg., reflexive; se mudó el Çid 'the Cid moved camp'; = se mudó)
puerto: puerto — mountain pass (Latin portus; al puerto de Alucat 'to the pass of Alucat'; = puerto)
alucat: Alucat — place name, a mountain pass (puerto de Alucat; Pidal: today Olocau del Rey, west of Morella, Castellón)
huesa: Huesa — Huesa, a town of the province of Teruel (Pidal), not Huesca (a Huesa e a Mont Alván; = Huesa)
alván: Alván — Albán, as in Mont Alván, Montalbán, a town in Teruel (= Alván, in Montalbán)
aquessa: aquesse — that (fem. sg.; aquessa corrida 'in that foray'; = esa, closest aquella)
dias: día — day (pl.; diez dias 'ten days'; = días)
morar: morar — to stay, dwell (infinitive; ovieron a morar 'they had to stay'; = morar)
salido: salir — gone out, exiled (past part., used as a noun; el salido de Castiella 'the one banished from Castile'; = salido)
idos: ir — gone, spread abroad (past part. masc. pl.; son idos 'have gone out'; = idos)
llegaron: llegar — they arrived (preterite 3rd pl.; llegaron las nuevas 'the news arrived'; = llegaron)
comde: conde — count (Pidal's co[m]de; al comde de Barçilona 'to the count of Barcelona'; = conde)
corrié: correr — he was running, raiding (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; quel corrié la tierra toda 'that he was raiding his whole land'; = corría)
tóvoslo: tener + se + lo — he took it (tovo, strong preterite 3rd sg. of tener, + se + lo; tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront'; = se lo tuvo)

__broaden__.val: valer — help! (imperative 2nd sg., apocopated for vale; = vale) · val — valley (noun, = valle; el val de río Martín 'the valley of the river Martín')
__broaden__.martín: Martín (Antolínez) — a knight of Burgos, companion of the Cid, who provisions him on his exile and negotiates the loan from Raquel and Vidas · also río Martín — the river Martín, in Aragon (el val de río Martín 'the valley of the river Martín'; = río Martín)
__broaden__.era: seer — it was (imperfect of seer = ser) · era + past part. 'had' (ser as pluperfect auxiliary with intransitives; Minaya assí era llegado 'Minaya had arrived')
__broaden__.a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day') · also a — 'has' before the participle, agreeing with the object (la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; a menester 'has need of'); a + dative of the person affected (a Minaya matáronle el cavallo 'they killed Minaya's horse') · a — 'as, for' (tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront')
__broaden__.mano: mano — hand (sg.); en vuestra mano = 'in your keeping' · a mano 'by hand, hand-picked' (escollechos a mano 'chosen by hand')
__broaden__.so: so/su — his, her, its (unstressed possessive sg.; so çervicio = su servicio); also seer — I am (1st sg. present; = soy; so ayrado, 'I am in [the king's] ira') · lo so — 'what is his, his own' (neuter article + possessive; lo so puede menguar 'what is his may dwindle')
__broaden__.corre: correr — it runs, flows (present 3rd sg.; = corre) · also corre — 'raids, ranges over' with a person as subject (dent corre mio Çid a Huesa 'from there the Cid raids to Huesa')
__broaden__.mont: Mont — mount, hill (Latin montem; = monte); Mont Mayor, the place Martín Muñoz held: Montemayor, a Portuguese town he governed for Alfonso VI, according to Pidal · also Mont Real — Monreal, name of the place above which the Cid's hill stands (Pidal: Monreal del Campo, on the Jiloca); see real · also Mont Alván — Montalbán, town in Teruel (a Mont Alván; = Montalbán)
__broaden__.trae: traer — he carries, brings (present 3rd sg.) · also trae mal — 'treats badly, harries' (el salido de Castiella así los trae tan mal 'the exile from Castile treats them so badly')
__broaden__.dent: dent — of it, thereof (de + ent, a form of ende 'thence'; non nos darán dent nada 'they will give us none of it'; = de ello) · also dent — from there, thence (dent corre mio Çid a Huesa 'from there the Çid raids to Huesa'; = de allí)
__broaden__.foron: seer — they were (preterite 3rd pl., variant of fueron; = fueron) · also foron — they went (ir, which shares this preterite; F[o]ron los mandados a todas partes 'the messages went everywhere')
__broaden__.compañas: compaña — company, band of troops (pl.; = compañas, closest tropas) · also compaña — the people of one's house, kin and household (de sus compañas, aquellas que avien dexado 'of their people, those they had left behind')
__broaden__.aquellas: aquel — those (fem. pl.; here referring back to the chests) · also aquellas que 'those which, those who' (de sus compañas, aquellas que avien dexado 'those they had left behind')
__broaden__.pesando: pesar — grieving, distressed (gerund; pesando va 'goes on grieving'; = pesando) · also pesar a — to grieve, weigh on (someone) (pesando va a los de Monçon 'it goes grieving the men of Monzón', i.e. it grieves them)
